scripts.dev:test: cross-env NODE_ENV=test APP_ENV=test ALLOW_TEST_DB_RESET=true DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db next dev -p 3100
scripts.build: prisma generate && prisma db push && next build
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:integration: cross-env NODE_ENV=test ALLOW_TEST_DB_RESET=true DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db vitest run --project integration
scripts.test:coverage: cross-env NODE_ENV=test ALLOW_TEST_DB_RESET=true DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db vitest run --coverage --project unit --project integration
scripts.test:e2e: cross-env NODE_ENV=test ALLOW_TEST_DB_RESET=true DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db playwright test
